title: Meet biosecurity conditions when importing conditionally non-prohibited goods
what: Goods that may be brought into Australia only subject to conditions must meet those conditions on import.

sources.title: Biosecurity Act 2015
sources.quote: 186 Contravening conditions applying to conditionally non-prohibited goods brought or imported into Australian territory (1) A person contravenes this subsection if: (a) the person brings or imports goods into Australian territory; and (b) the goods are conditionally non-prohibited goods; and (c) a condition in relation to the goods specified in a determination in force under subsection 174(1) has not been complied with.
